zh-CN.title: 多设备未读状态更准确
items: 自己发送的消息不再被标记为未读
其他设备补同步聊天记录时不再制造虚假红点
未读数统一以账户的服务端阅读进度为准

en.title: Accurate unread state across devices
items: Messages you send no longer count as unread
Backfilled history on another device no longer creates false badges
Unread counts now follow the account's server-side read position
